elements.label: Cursor switching from grab hand to arrow to pointer hand after the drop

pattern.description: The tail of the drag-and-drop from e062: the presenter releases the Onboarding templates card, it snaps a few pixels left into the Next column's slot, the cursor reverts from grab hand to arrow, and the card then shows its hover tint as the pointer rests on it.
pattern.why_premium: The crisp snap and immediate hover feedback confirm the drop landed, closing the prioritisation gesture cleanly just as the narrator moves on to board views.

build_hint.gsap: On release: gsap.to('.card-onboarding', {x: slotX, y: slotY, scale: 1, boxShadow: 'none', duration: 0.12, ease: 'power3.out'}); swap the cursor sprite to arrow at drop and to pointer ~0.3s later, then gsap.to('.card-onboarding', {backgroundColor: hoverTint, duration: 0.05}).
build_hint.remotion: const settle = spring({frame: frame - drop, fps, config: {damping: 24, stiffness: 320, mass: 0.6}}); translateX = interpolate(settle, [0, 1], [dragX, slotX]); cursor sprite chosen by frame ranges; background tint toggles on at drop + ~10 frames.

notes: Continuation of the e062 drag; the energy peaks are the drop snap (~f3518) and the hover tint/cursor change (~f3529). Column counts also change between e062 and this end frame (Later 3 to 2, Next 1 to 2), but there is no candidate box for them and the exact frame is not visible in the filmstrip crop, so they are not listed. No SFX candidates.
